info.title: Daily Stock Analysis API
info.description:
Watchlist analysis API for A-shares, Hong Kong and US stocks

## Modules
- Stock analysis: trigger AI analysis
- History: query historical analysis reports
- Stock data: fetch quote data

## Authentication
Optional admin authentication. When ADMIN_AUTH_ENABLED=true, /api/v1/* requires a valid admin session cookie, except for login, status, health check and the OpenAPI docs. When disabled, authentication is not enforced.

post.summary: Create or deduplicate a decision signal
post.description: Explicitly writes a DecisionSignal. When horizon/expires_at are omitted the service applies a default lifetime. Hitting the same-source dedup key, or a narrow relaxed dedup, returns the existing record with created=false. Creating an active signal or renewing an expired one invalidates the previous opposite active signal for the same stock, and an active duplicate retry re-runs that repair. Ordinary old duplicate/replay calls are not treated as new activation events. Absolute idempotency under concurrency is not guaranteed.

get.description: Returns paginated DecisionSignals. Active signals past expires_at are lazily expired before reading. When source_type=analysis and only source_report_id is supplied, a miss triggers a one-off lazy backfill from that historical report (first list hit only; this exact query performs a read-with-write backfill and does not affect other paginated filter combinations). holding_only=true reads only cached portfolio_positions of active accounts and does not trigger a portfolio snapshot replay.
